verdict.rationale: Decagon is a SaaS platform that could plausibly offer versioned public APIs, so this axis applies. The only 'versioning' mention refers to technical teams controlling agent guardrails, integrations, and versioning, not to API versioning, and nothing documents a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so the pack has no evidence of versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
